examples.text: Das Immunsystem des <w>Wirts</w> stieß das transplantierte Spenderorgan leider ab.

target_lang_translations.en: Unfortunately, the <w>host</w>'s immune system rejected the transplanted donor organ.

target_lang_translations.zh: 很遗憾，<w>受体</w>的免疫系统排斥了移植的供体器官。

target_lang_translations.en: Prior to the procedure, doctors checked the biological compatibility between donor and <w>recipient</w>.

target_lang_translations.nl: Vóór de ingreep controleerden de artsen de biologische compatibiliteit tussen donor en <w>ontvanger</w>.
